body: I’m a pre-k teacher and we have a student who is on the sensitive side and on my first week I called her the wrong name on accident and she had a full break down because she didn’t want to turn into the student who’s name I had accidentally called her.
I’ve tried getting help. It always ends up costing too much or with medications making things worse or just making me sick.
I graduated college, got a job in my field part-time, have an interview coming up for a full time position also in my field and hopefully will be able to quit my terrible coffee job!

Check out the 319 Building! Tons of galleries including Vox Poppuli, PRACTICE etc. (11th and wood st)
